notes.title: Update 1.0.5 free movement mode added, Yuma boss bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we just added the new update that fixes:
1. Game stucking when you can defeat Yuma the first time you meet her.
For anyone who falls into this case, please update and check if you can continue the game, in another case that may cause it to be stuck forever, you need to start the game over again or send us your save file and we will try to fix it for you.
2. We added a new mode "Free movement" where you can move your character freely without beat hitting.
For any issue, please contact us in the community:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1602490/discussions/0/3198115500352049000/

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 difficulty and music changes/improvement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We just updated the game to 1.0.3 with following changes:

1. We just updated the game to 1.0.3 with following changes:
2. We realize some music tracks are really hard to hear and follow the beat, so we decided to change and improve music for these areas: Rolling Hills, Frostburn.
[b]You will find 3 new soundtracks in the game, and 2 tracks are removed, one track has changed.[/b]
4. Improve several enemy damage and hp and behaviour for easier to defeat. Overall the game is easier now.
5. Fix bug that cause battle stuck when fast moving between the village and rolling hill
6. Several minors bug fixes

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 critical bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We have updated the game to version 1.0.2 that fixes some critical bugs and has several improvements.

[b]Here is the detail:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix bug that the rhythm bar is disappeared cause softlock in the battle
[*] Fix bug that side quest (Mina, Erika, Sakura’s sidequest) can be lost or missed
[*] Fix bug that achievement “The magic source” is not unlocked
[*] Fix layer issue of the bomb in Fuji’s hideout
[*] Decrease the sell price of the bomb
[*] Decrease the difficulty of the last puzzle by removing several notes.
[*] Some minors bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - Rhythm battle stuck and side quest fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We have updated the game to 1.0.1 that fixes these two critical issues:
- Sometimes the rhythm bars disappear or missing notes that cause softlock/stuck in the battle.
- Cannot receive or miss the side quest for Mina and Sakura.

We also keep updating the game to fix bugs and improve other things.
If you found any problem or have an idea to improve the game, don't hesitate to contact us via community:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1602490/discussions/0/3198115500352049000/
Cheer!
